details:
Q1. Which part of this repository should change?
Choices:
A. Clarify/plan pipeline behavior (`clarify*`, `plan*`, prompt/rendering pieces)
B. Implement/review pipeline behavior (`implement*`, `review_autofix*`, related scripts)
C. Orchestrator/validation/runtime automation (`orchestrate*`, `validate*`, judge/poller helpers)
D. Documentation/templates only (`README.md`, `docs/**`, `workflow-templates/**`)
E. Specify the exact workflow(s), script(s), or file path(s) to change (RECOMMENDED)
Q2. What concrete improvement should this issue target?
Choices:
A. Bug/regression: give the current behavior, expected behavior, and affected workflow/script (RECOMMENDED)
B. Failed or stalled automation run: give the run/PR/issue number and the exact failing step or symptom (RECOMMENDED)
C. Docs/template problem: name the file/section and what is unclear or wrong
D. Performance/cost problem: name the phase plus the current pain and the target outcome
